labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I have no objection to your researching pay and benefits. But this doesn't belong among the ward handover documents.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I-I'm sorry! I put it in the wrong place when I was sorting everything!”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She quickly takes the sheet back and slips it into her notebook. The handwriting and tables on it are clearly very neat.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Just then, Ryuji Sakaguchi enters the nurses' station.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Dr. Sakaguchi, perfect timing. Let me introduce an intern who is starting today.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: The girl immediately turns toward Sakaguchi and bows carefully.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “It's nice to meet you! I'm Megumi Kariya, and I'm starting my internship here today. I look forward to working with you!”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Hello, Kariya. You're certainly full of energy for your first day.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Of course! I've really been looking forward to this internship.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “The internship begins on June first and lasts six months. The final assessment will be on December first. The nursing department will arrange your duties. Start by learning the daily routines in each department.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Yes! I've already read all the instructions you sent me.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Hiroko Sugimura, who is sorting patient records nearby, looks up at her with a smile.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I hear you're keen to work at our hospital after you graduate?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I'd like to stay after graduation.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You've already decided?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Yes. I've compared the offers, and the pay and benefits here are the best.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She pauses, then hastily adds something.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “...I mean, there's so much I can learn here!”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “There's nothing wrong with what you said the first time.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Huh?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “It's perfectly normal to want to earn money through your own work.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Megumi visibly relaxes.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “That's a relief. I was worried that saying that on my first day would give everyone a bad impression of me.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “My family needs the money, and I want to become independent sooner, too. If I'm going to study hard and work hard during my internship, of course I want a well-paying job afterward.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Sounds like you've really done your homework.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Yes! I'm confident about that part.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Then let's see how much homework you've done on nursing.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction
H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: The phone at the nurses' station rings. Hiroko is busy checking the handover documents. Megumi instinctively reaches for it, then stops and looks at Ishigami.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “May I answer it?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Ishigami nods.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Listen carefully to what the caller needs first. If you're unsure about something, leave the answer to the person responsible.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Megumi picks up the phone. Her slightly embarrassed expression immediately turns serious.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Hello, you've reached the nurses' station. This is Kariya speaking.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “...All right. Take your time. I'll write it down.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She opens her notebook and takes notes on a blank page, nodding gently as she listens.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You'd like to confirm the time of your preoperative tests, is that right?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I'm not able to answer that myself yet. May I check with the nurse in charge and have her get back to you?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: The person on the other end says a little more.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Yes, I understand you're worried. I'll make sure your question is passed on clearly. Please hold.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She puts down the phone and hands her notes to Hiroko.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Ms. Sugimura, this patient wants to confirm her preoperative test schedule. I've written down her name, ward, and question, but I don't know the exact time, so I couldn't just give her an answer.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Hiroko takes the paper and glances over it.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Thank you. These are very clear notes. I'll contact the nurse responsible.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Great! I'll take notes like this next time, too.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “One more thing, Kariya.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Yes?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “It's good that you took the initiative to check what you didn't know on the phone. But you don't need to rush to do everyone's work on your very first day.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Oh... am I getting ahead of myself?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “A little.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Understood. I'll be more careful.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She quickly adds a line to her notebook.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Hiroko sets a rotation schedule in front of her.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “During your internship, you'll experience the work of different departments. You'll gradually learn the nursing routines on the wards, in outpatients, and in the operating room.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “The wards, outpatients...”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: At the words “operating room,” her pen suddenly stops.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “...I have to go to the operating room, too.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “What's wrong? Don't you like operating rooms?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “It's not that I don't like them. It's just... I've never actually stood beside someone having an operation.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I can look at all the pictures at school. But when I see it for real... I don't know how I'll react.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She tries to keep smiling, but her fingers unconsciously tighten around the edge of her notebook.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “If I don't do well then, will it affect my internship assessment?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Your assessment is based on how you learn and work over these six months. It won't be decided by your first attempt alone.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “If you really feel unwell, tell a senior nurse right away. Pushing yourself until you can't even look after yourself won't help the patient.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “...All right. I'll remember that.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She looks down, writes another line, then raises her head again.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Then I'll keep studying ahead! I spent ages memorizing the operating room preparation procedure yesterday. I can't let that go to waste.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Being prepared is good. But once you're actually there, you also need to judge how you're coping.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Yes, Dr. Sakaguchi.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Just then, Ange Tonegawa enters the nurses' station carrying a neatly sorted stack of patient records.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Ms. Ishigami, the ward records are all sorted. Is there anything else I can help with?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Good timing. Ange, show Kariya, who is starting today, the routes around the wards and the nurses' station.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Ange turns to Megumi with a friendly smile.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Hello, I'm Ange Tonegawa. If there's anything you're unsure about, you can ask me.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Hi! I'm Megumi Kariya. You look about my age.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Yes, I'm eighteen.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Really? I'm eighteen, too!”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She suddenly notices Ange's permanent nurse's name badge.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Oh, you're already a staff nurse?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Yes, but I still have plenty to learn.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I see...”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She looks at Ange's badge for a moment, then smiles.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Then I'll have to work hard to catch up with you. In six months, I want to wear a badge like that, too.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Then let's both do our best. Come with me and learn your way around the wards first.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Okay!”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Megumi gathers her notebook and follows Ange toward the nurses' station exit. After a couple of steps, she turns back and bows earnestly to Sakaguchi, Hiroko, and Ishigami.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I'm really looking forward to working with all of you, starting today!”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Welcome to Hoshimi Hospital.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “There's no need to rush. Learn one thing at a time.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I know. But... I've already done the math.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “The math for what?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “If I can stay here, life will be a lot easier financially for both me and my family. I'm going to work hard for these six months to make that happen.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She speaks with complete sincerity, then returns to her cheerful smile.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Well then, I'd better get to work!”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Ange waits for her by the door. The two leave the nurses' station side by side.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Once outside, Megumi quietly glances through the rotation schedule.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Ange... do you see blood very often in the operating room?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Yes. Of course you'll see blood in an operating room.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “...I thought so.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She falls silent for a moment, then closes her notebook.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “It's all right. I'll focus on learning what I can today!”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction
